snippet.title: AUTOMATE DEATH — Incremental tower-defense
snippet.description:
AUTOMATE DEATH is a tower defense game where you hold the road against tens of thousands of goblins at once. Build automated gun defenses, call in air strikes, and watch massive goblin hordes meet your defense. Wishlist it on Steam!

Place miniguns, railguns, howitzers, HIMARS, C-RAM, minefields and tanks along the road, then unleash player-called strikes — AC-130 gunships, A-10 Warthog runs, B-52 carpet bombing, Tomahawk missiles and a nuclear ICBM. Every battle, won or lost, earns XP toward 419 permanent upgrades, so your defense keeps growing stronger.

🎮 Features
• Huge goblin hordes — tens of thousands of enemies on screen at once
• 20+ deployable weapons and vehicles, plus 7+ aircraft units
• 420+ permanent research upgrades — an incremental tower defense where progress never resets
• A 125-map campaign with new goblin types, bosses and the Goblin King
• Custom map editor — design your own maps, roads and goblin waves
• Windows, macOS and Linux

👉 Wishlist AUTOMATE DEATH on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5304530/AUTOMATE_DEATH/

If you like tower defense, strategy, incremental and horde survival games, this one's for you. Comment how long you'd hold the lane!
